title: Miro Interactive Presentation Mode: Your Most Interactive Presentations Yet

summary.tone: Friendly, upbeat, product-native walkthrough: a calm persona-led VO (Ashley the PM) over bright, playful board content with illustrated stickers and an upbeat ~123 BPM music bed; collaborative and light rather than salesy.

signature_moments.description: Opening collage: a recreated Present menu pulls back into a drifting field of floating UI fragments (vote stickies with confetti, reaction bar, emoji, 3D watch) around a static bold 'Interactive presentations' title.
signature_moments.why_premium: Deconstructing the product into floating, shadowed UI props with layered parallax-like drift reads as bespoke motion design rather than a screen capture, and previews every feature before the demo.

signature_moments.description: Key controls (frame list toolbar, 'Choose a new presenter' popover) are isolated on an empty canvas, one with a perspective tilt, while the scripted cursor operates them.
signature_moments.why_premium: Removing the board clutter focuses attention on a single interaction and gives the screen recording a designed, editorial rhythm.

signature_moments.description: The Q&A frame fills with popping stickers, rising reactions with avatars and a confetti burst on 'post stickers and reactions', then resolves to the 'Miro is a space for all people' line with a hand-drawn circle around 'all'.
signature_moments.why_premium: The payoff visually performs the benefit (an engaged audience) instead of stating it, and the hand-drawn annotation ties the brand line back to the whiteboard medium.

hook.evidence: Visually attractive feature-collage title in the first 3.7 s, but there is no stated problem or claim and narration only begins at w0 (~7.4 s), so the hook relies on aesthetics alone.

clarity.evidence: One persona and one meeting carry the story in a logical order (start, navigate, facilitation tools, hand off, viewer join, catch up, react), with each VO clause matched by an on-screen action; the long static hold in s017 slightly blunts the ending.

ui_showcase.evidence: Real product UI throughout with scripted named cursors, camera push-ins to the toolbar and popovers, and isolated UI panels for the key interactions; some moments are small and busy at full-board scale (join pop-up text unreadable in s013).

motion_polish.evidence: Smooth eased board pans and pushes with motion blur, perspective-tilted isolated cards, crossfades between full board and isolated UI, sticker pops and a confetti burst; however s017 holds nearly static for ~10 s (about 1:16-1:27) before the end card.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchor audio facts plus visuals: a continuous music bed at 123.05 BPM, integrated loudness -18.83 LUFS, and most of the 166 SFX candidates classified as music; distinct SFX are sparse (chime candidates x001-x010 in the opening, one click x143, swoosh_reverse x161 near the close), so UI actions like sticker pops are not clearly sonified.

vo_script_quality.evidence: Clear, persona-driven narration that maps cleanly to actions ('clicks on the present button', 'hand off presenting to Sophia'), but it is a feature list with few benefits until w154-w161 and closes on a soft statement rather than an ask.

brand_consistency.evidence: Consistent white canvas, Miro product typography, coral/teal/blue slide palette and illustrated stickers throughout; the end card returns to the Miro wordmark board UI and brand line.

works_muted.evidence: Beyond the opening title and closing line there are no captions or explanatory supertitles; actions are visible, but features such as limited tools, the presenter hand-off and the viewer join pop-up are only explained by VO.

overall.evidence: A polished, competent product-native feature explainer with a strong designed opening and some isolated-UI moments, held back by a hook without a problem statement, sparse sound design, VO dependence and a long static hold before a soft, CTA-less ending.

localization_friendliness.notes: Board frames, sticky notes, popovers, illustrated stickers ('MISSING FEEDBACK', 'GENIUS', 'THANK YOU') and the title/end lines are baked into recorded or recreated UI; localising requires re-recording the board in each language plus new VO, and the story relies on narration to explain features.

annotation.focal_element: Floating 'Present' dropdown menu (Board / All frames / Smart Meeting) under a toolbar strip with a blue Share button

Run a collaborative session with apps and activities
Look at those awsome new stickers!

annotation.what_happens: Opens mid-motion on an isolated, enlarged Present menu on a white canvas; within about half a second the camera pulls back so the menu shrinks toward centre while other floating UI fragments (a sticker sticky note, a large Share button, a coral card edge) drift in from the edges, establishing a collage.
annotation.build_rebuild: Place a recreated Present-menu component at 1.0 scale on a white canvas and tween the whole canvas group from scale 1.6 to 1.0 over ~0.6 s with a strong ease-out, while 3-4 satellite UI cards (sticky note, Share button, coral card) slide in from the frame edges with slight motion blur.

annotation.focal_element: Centered bold title 'Interactive presentations' surrounded by floating product elements (sticky notes with vote badges, reaction bar, emoji, Present menu, 3D smartwatch render)
annotation.typography: Title in a heavy geometric sans (low-confidence guess: Roobert/Gilroy Bold), sentence case, two stacked lines, tight leading, normal tracking, near-black; sticky-note labels in a regular sans, centered; reaction-bar labels small medium-weight UI sans.
annotation.what_happens: Title card: the camera keeps drifting/pushing across a collage so peripheral elements slide out left (Present menu, 'Data analysed' card) while yellow voting sticky notes with confetti, a raised-hand icon, a reaction toolbar with floating heart and fire emoji, and a 3D smartwatch settle around the static centered title; by the end a blue hand icon and a timer card enter from the right.
annotation.build_rebuild: Fix a two-line bold title at frame centre and translate a larger background layer of absolutely positioned UI props (sticky notes, reaction bar, emoji, product render) slowly right-to-left with ease-in-out over ~3 s, adding a short confetti burst around the vote stickies and floating the emoji upward with a gentle yoyo.

on_screen_text: Align on the problem statement and next steps
annotation.typography: Native Miro product UI: small regular sans in the top bar and toolbars; board title in medium weight; frames use bold white sans headings in sentence case with small bullet body text; cursor tag is a small medium-weight label on a yellow pill.
annotation.what_happens: Starts with the collage continuing (timer widget push-in to a large '02' with pause/stop controls), then a fast transition lands on the Miro board UI: the camera pans/zooms down from a chart area to a row of slide frames, settles to a framing of four frames as narration starts (w0 'Ashley, the product manager...'), Ashley's cursor moves up to the top-right Present button (w14-w18 'clicks on the present button'), and the last frame begins a zoom into the first slide.
annotation.build_rebuild: Show a full-frame board screenshot/recording inside a scalable camera container, tween its translate/scale from an overview of the chart area to the frame row (~1.5 s ease-in-out), hold while a labeled custom cursor animates along a curved path to the Present button synced to word w17, then start a zoom-in toward the first frame.

annotation.focal_element: First presentation slide 'Smartwatch Post-Launch Review' with the 3D smartwatch render and presenter avatars
annotation.typography: Slide content: wordmark 'awesomewatch' with bold 'awesome' and light 'watch'; title in bold geometric sans, title case, two lines, white; names in bold small white with roles in regular weight beneath; cursor tag small medium-weight on yellow pill.
annotation.what_happens: Presentation mode: the first frame fills the screen almost edge to edge with a slim vertical tool strip at left and Ashley's cursor near the watch; the frame holds nearly static while VO says she can present any content on the board (w19-w28); at the end the camera pulls back slightly revealing the white board and the edge of the next frame on the right.
annotation.build_rebuild: Display the slide frame full-bleed with a minimal 3-icon toolbar overlay on the left and a labeled cursor, hold ~3.5 s with a very slow scale drift, then tween scale down to ~0.8 and translate left over ~0.5 s so the next frame peeks in from the right.

annotation.focal_element: An isolated, perspective-tilted presentation toolbar with its frame list (1. Intro, 2. Goals, 3. Data, 4. Feedback, 5. Data) and Ashley's cursor
annotation.typography: Small UI sans, regular weight, sentence case with numbered list items and right-aligned duration labels; cursor tag in medium-weight sans on a yellow pill. Rendered italic-looking only because of the skewed plane.

annotation.focal_element: The presentation toolbar's facilitation popover (Breakout frames, Timer, Voting, Limited Tools toggle and tool icons) with Ashley's cursor
on_screen_text: Align on the problem statement and next steps

on_screen_text: Align on the problem statement and next steps

annotation.focal_element: The 'Choose a new presenter' handoff popover above the presentation toolbar

annotation.focal_element: The 'Questions, answers, and feedback' frame filling up with stickers, floating reactions, confetti, a timer widget and comment sticky notes, ending on the centred line 'Miro is a space for all people'
on_screen_text: Meeting next week to track progress?
Can't wait to see our user's reactions!
Miro is a space for all people
annotation.typography: Frame headline in bold blue rounded geometric sans, sentence case; sticker lettering is illustrated hand-drawn display type in all caps ('MISSING FEEDBACK', 'GENIUS', 'THANK YOU'); comment sticky notes in small regular dark sans; timer digits in medium-weight tabular sans; closing line 'Miro is a space for all people' in bold near-black geometric sans, sentence case, normal tracking, centred, with a hand-drawn blue circle around 'all'. Font guess (low confidence): Miro's brand geometric sans.
annotation.what_happens: A pan from the green 'thanks' frame lands on the Q&A frame (with 'MISSING FEEDBACK' and 'GENIUS' stickers) and holds while VO says no one has to passively watch (w153-w161). On 'post stickers and reactions' (w173-w177) star, heart and thumbs-up stickers pop in at the top-left, then thumbs-up, heart and fire reactions with avatars float up from the toolbar, followed by a confetti burst and new 'THANK YOU' and mug stickers (w178-w188). A timer widget appears top-right at 05:00 and counts down (w189-w195), and two comment sticky notes are added (w197-w200). The board holds through the closing VO line naming Miro's new presentation mode (w201-w218), then fades to white as 'Miro is a space for all people' fades in large and centred, scales down into a recreated board UI collage (watch render, Switch presenter button, reaction bar, 05:02 timer, fire/heart sticky) with a hand-drawn circle around 'all', and finally fades to white.
annotation.build_rebuild: Hold a full-frame board view, spawn stickers with a pop (scale 0 to 1.1 to 1 spring) and float emoji+avatar reactions upward with fade-out, fire a short confetti particle burst, slide a countdown timer card into the top-right, then crossfade to a white canvas with a centred bold headline that scales from ~1.3 to 1.0 while recreated UI props fade in around it and a stroke-dashoffset circle draws around one word before a final fade to white.
